events.title: 70K Wishlists, Next Fest & What's Coming in the Full Release
events.summary: GRR GRR, 70K GNOMES! 🍄⚓We're honestly a bit speechless. Grr Grr Gnomes just passed 70,000 wishlists! This little crew of angry gnomes has come a long way.And to celebrate, we're part of Steam Next Fest! Grab the demo, round up your crew, and show the islands who's boss. events.title: Over 10,000 Wishlists!
events.summary: We've gathered over 10,000 wishlists in just 5 days! 🤯 We've been listening to everything you guys are saying in our Discord, discord.gg/grrgrrgnomes. and we've already fixed a ton of bugs, from ships randomly flying off into different galaxies to coconuts completely glitching out players. With Steam Next Fest getting closer, we're putting all the time we have into making the game feel better, play better, and fixing as much chaos as possible! events.title: 1,000 Wishlists — Thank You, Gnomes
events.summary: 800 gnomes at sea. 1,000 wishlists. Two days. We shipped the demo expecting a few dozen people to drown politely. Instead: 800 concurrent players at peak. Over 1,000 wishlists. For a two-person team that spent the last stretch arguing about whether the kraken should be bigger, this is genuinely absurd. Thank you. events.title: DEMO RELEASED!!
events.summary: Welcome aboard you little gnome! 🧙‍♂️As you know this game is fully physics-based. That means gnomes will fly, flip, bounce, and ragdoll in ways that we never intended. We fixed a LOT of bugs during testing... but let's be honest, we definitely missed some. (Probably a lot)So if you see an item clipping through the floor, launching into orbit, or achieving forbidden physics please screenshot it, clip it, and come tell us on Discord. You'll be doing your civic gnome duty.https://discord.gg/grrgrr
